## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`): I agree to the [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org/).
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes on my machine.
- [ ] New source files start with `// SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-or-later`.
- [ ] Docs changed where behaviour changed (guides, and the doc in `docs/` that describes it).
- [ ] If the change is visible to hosts or members, it has a line under "Unreleased" in `CHANGELOG.md`.
